claims.text: Cardinals.com's game recap says Mack Wilson Sr. left briefly with a thumb injury but returned.
claims.quote: Linebacker Mack Wilson Sr. left briefly with a thumb injury but returned.

claims.text: Seahawks.com says George Holani briefly left the Week 2 game to be evaluated and was cleared to return. Cleared to return is not the word returned, so the outcome stays unconfirmed.
claims.quote: Running back George Holani also briefly left the game to be evaluated in the fourth quarter, but Macdonald said he was cleared to return.

claims.text: Wednesday's NFL.com roundup listed George Holani as knee and limited. The in-game sentence did not name a body part, so this record does not relabel the evaluation as a knee injury.
claims.quote: George Holani (knee) limited

claims.text: Buccaneers.com says Josiah Trotter suffered a shoulder injury in the third quarter but did come back into the game. Came back is not the word returned, so the outcome stays unconfirmed.
claims.quote: Rookie linebacker Josiah Trotter suffered a shoulder injury in the third quarter but did come back into the game, finishing with 48 defensive snaps and a team-high 11 tackles.

claims.text: The Wednesday injury report says Josiah Trotter (shoulder) did not participate in practice. That is a next-week practice note, not a change to the in-game wording.
claims.quote: Josiah Trotter (shoulder) did not participate in practice.

claims.text: Packers.com's game recap says Bo Melton was announced with a stinger being examined. Anthony Campbell is named in the same sentence and is a separate archived incident.
claims.quote: WR Bo Melton (stinger) and DT Anthony Campbell (ankle) also were announced as having injuries examined.

claims.text: Packers.com's game recap says Jordan Love took a shot to his elbow, his hand went numb, and he kept playing without missing a snap. Kept playing is not recorded as the word returned.
claims.quote: Love even was in the injury mix, taking a shot to his elbow on the play he fumbled, which he said left his hand numb for a while. But he kept playing and didn't miss any snaps.
